headlines.text: On a Friday in 2023, back when El Hijo del Vikingo vs. Black Taurus clashed for the AAA Mega Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 8.23 ? an excellent showing. Black Taurus was challenging for gold for the very first time. Vikingo survived a discus lariat and a fireman's-carry powerbomb from Taurus before finishing him with a 630 senton to retain the AAA Mega Championship.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when FTR & MJF announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.93 ? a match that delivered.
That Friday in 2023, Matt Taven stepped back through the curtain after just under 3 months away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. Rocky Romero went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a solid showing.
2021 brought us this moment: it marked the first-ever meeting between Adam Cole and Orange Cassidy, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.05 ? a solid showing.
Back on this day in 2021, it marked the first-ever meeting between Ruby Soho and Nyla Rose on Dynamite, rated 5.86.
